full_judgment: 6. Mr Harendra Nath Nondy, learned Advocate for the opposite party No. 1, submits that opposite party No. 1 is on the land as a successive owner in possession. His father's name was recorded in the SA Khatian and they have been possessing the suit land all along on payment of rents. Opposite Party No. 1 has also got his homestead on the land. Having come to know that the alleged vendor opposite party No. 2 migrated to India long ago and died the petitioner instituted the suit and if a decree is obtained, naturally ex parte, in such suit it will be very difficult for opposite party No. 1 to protect his possession in the land. He, therefore, submits that in order to avoid multiplicity of the proceedings and also for ends of justice presence of opposite party No. 1 is necessary at least to prove that the vendor of the petitioner migrated to India long ago and died there long before the execution of Bainapatra on 12-6-1995. In support he cites decisions in the case of Muhammad lshaq vs Jamila Begum and others reported in PLD 1955 Lahore 644, in the case of Surjya Kanta Majhi and another vs Aswini Kumar Debnath and others, 16 DLR 238 and that of Barjang Lal Agarwala vs Aksed Ali Shaikh & others, 35 DLR 110 and that of Md Toafazzal Hossain vs Sunil Kumar Basak & ors 7 BLT (AD) 103.
